subject: Startups
title: Latin America's Nubank Revolution
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Latin America's Nubank Revolution.

hook.text: Nubank launched with a purple credit card and zero fees.

buildup.text: Brazilian banks charged up to 400% annual interest on credit cards. Five banks controlled 80% of the market.

discovery.text: Nubank offered a mobile-first, no-fee bank account. Millions signed up.

twist.text: Warren Buffett invested $500 million in Nubank. He rarely bets on tech.

climax.text: Nubank IPO'd in 2021 at $41 billion—larger than any traditional Brazilian bank.

punchline.text: Challenge a broken system and millions will switch.

quiz.question: What made Nubank revolutionary in Brazil?
options: It offered the highest interest rates
It provided fee-free banking in a market of high fees
It was backed by the government
